THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the lands described below is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

The Land bounded by following names and extents depicted in Advance Tracing No. KI/PNK/2023/174 dated 28.06.2023 prepared by the of Survey General, situated in the village called Veddukadu in the Grama Niladhari Division No. KN/67 of Paramankirai in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Punakari of Kilinochchi District, in Northern Province and bounded as follows:

01. Lot C – Vettilaikenikadu, Sodalaipiddi - Extent: 2.5478 Hectares North: Vettilaikenikadu, Lots A and B; East:Lot B and Sodalaipiddi; South: Sodalaipiddi and Sea; West: Sea, Vettilaikenikadu and Lot A.
Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands.
My Ref. No.: 4-3/11/2022/RE/290.Ministry of Tourism and Lands,“Mihikatha Medura”, Rajamalwatta Avenue, Battaramulla.11th December, 2023.
